_meta.about: Golden set for retrieval evals. expected = articles that must appear in the top 5 retrieved articles. evidence = case-insensitive regex that must match the article text, checked on every run so the set stays tied to the law JSON. dev questions were used while tuning expansions; holdout questions were written first and only measured, not tuned on.
_meta.scope: core scope in docs/ai.js (AMLR, TFR, AMLD6, AMLAR, DORA, MiCA, PSD2, GDPR, EMD2)
